about.heading: Engineering with purpose, designing with intention.
about.bio1: I'm a full-stack developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web applications and thoughtful user interfaces. I believe great software is built at the intersection of clean engineering and intentional design.
about.bio2: With a background spanning both engineering and design, I bring a holistic perspective to every project. I specialize in React ecosystems, Node.js backends, and creating interfaces that feel as good as they work. Currently open to exciting opportunities and collaborations.
about.philosophy: I write code the same way I design — with intention. Every line should serve a purpose, every component should earn its place. I value simplicity, clarity, and the kind of craftsmanship that users feel even when they can't quite explain it.

experience.subheading: Places I've contributed to, roles I've grown through, and teams I've learned from.

1.description: Leading frontend architecture for the Next.js dashboard and developer tooling products. Working closely with the design and DevEx teams.
responsibilities: Led rewrite of the deployment dashboard — reduced load time by 60%.
Architected a new component library adopted across 4 product teams.
Mentored 3 junior engineers and ran bi-weekly frontend office hours.
Collaborated with design to build a fully accessible UI token system.

2.description: Worked on the Stripe Dashboard, focusing on the financial reporting and data visualization surfaces used by millions of merchants.
responsibilities: Built the new Revenue Recognition module from scratch.
Improved chart rendering performance by 40% via virtualization.
Drove adoption of TypeScript across the dashboard codebase.
Participated in Stripe's internal design system working group.

3.description: Contributed to the Figma web platform and plugin ecosystem during a high-growth period. Worked with the editor team on performance improvements.
responsibilities: Optimized canvas rendering for large design files.
Developed internal tooling for the plugin review workflow.

4.description: Designed and developed web products for startups and small businesses across e-commerce, SaaS, and media verticals.
responsibilities: Delivered 20+ projects across e-commerce, SaaS, and media.
Built custom CMS solutions and headless e-commerce storefronts.
Provided UX consulting and design system workshops.
